visual_logic: Highlights the extraordinarily complex, multi-pointed, serrated crushing teeth unique to Eudimorphodon.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of a close-up jaw segment from an Eudimorphodon, showcase-focused on its 'Multi-Cusped Saw' dentition, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized edges. Each individual ivory tooth is heavily stylized, revealing an intricate leaf-like or crown-like shape with three to five miniature sharp points (cusps) on a single tooth crown, arranged in a dense, interlocking pinking-shear row. The texture is a pristine bone-white with smooth tactile finishes. The specimen is oriented vertically and perfectly centered in a 1:1 square composition, carefully scaled to occupy the central power-zone, ensuring a strict 25% negative space safety margin on all four sides. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with high-contrast contact shadows. Illuminated by soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion to clearly illuminate the micro-architectural detail of each multi-pointed tooth crown.
